# v0.6.13

## Bug Fixes
- Model and Mmproj folders now auto-save with 800ms debounce on input change
- Update-related UI now uses correct theme colors (peach instead of orange)
- Update check button moved to Notifications section in Settings
- Update error messages now displayed in Settings UI

## Maintenance
- Removed test release artifacts from repository
- Updated .gitignore to exclude signing artifacts
